title: Allah ka zakir
body:
Allah ka zakir
Mujhe bhool jaaye duniya, me agar tujhe bhuladu ya hussain
<<MINI>>
(ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Teeron ki musalleh par tune, jo sajda kiya koi kar na sakaa
(jis khaak pe tera khoon bahaa) x2
Us khaak par har zayir ne kahaa
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya ye bhulayegi kaise, bazaar jafaa me jab tune
(Quran sunaya naize par) x2
Quran mukhatib tujse huwa
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
chand aur sitaare daame falak, rizwaane jinaa sab huro malak
(sab farsh ke sabke aur shajar) x2
Hai sab ke labon par aik sadaa
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah ki tune laaj rakhi, tawheed teri makrooz huwi, (allah allah ye shaan teri) x2 Phir kyun na kahe har hamde khuda
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
bartaa tu use milti na ajar, imdaad teri zahra ke pisar
(mit ta tha jahaan se deene khuda) x2
ab kehta rahega deen sadaa
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh ke boj halhaatho ne, ye baat likhi hai rote huwe
(ay shere khuda ke laal salaam) x2
kehte hai tuje khud shere khuda
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
wo milta ye ghairat binte ali jo tere sahaare jeete ti
(jab mehwe tilawat dekha tuje) x2
kehta tha dile mehroome ridaa
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye kushtae teghe zulmo jafaa, hai tujsa namaaze kon bhalaa
(naize se aqaamat tune kahi) x2
Teeron ke muselleh ne ye kahaa
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
irfane nabi Irfane khuda, mujko to azaa khano se mila
(ay mazhar yazdaan ke beche) x2
sajde me yahi mazhar ne kahaa
<<MINI>>
(Allah ka tu zakir hai) x2 Aur tera zaakir me hu hussain
(Ya hussain) x2
